summary: This case study describes the Employee Wellness Program at Solstice Innovations, a mid-sized technology firm, focusing on its Mental Health Support and Counseling Services policy. The policy combines confidential counseling, paid mental health days, work-life balance measures, and education on mental health. The company monitors utilization and collects anonymous feedback, and credits the program with strong retention and satisfaction.
one_line: Case study of Solstice Innovations' wellness program, covering confidential counseling, paid mental health days, work-life balance, education, and outcome assessment.
key_facts: Solstice Innovations is a mid-sized technology firm known for forward-thinking policies and investment in human capital.
The wellness program aims to keep employees healthy physically, mentally, and emotionally.
All employees get up to six free sessions per year with a licensed therapist through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Counseling sessions can be held in person, over the phone, or via teleconferencing to serve remote employees.
Employees are encouraged to take up to three paid mental health days per year, separate from sick leave or vacation time.
Work-life balance is supported through flexible work hours, remote work options, and a culture that discourages excessive overtime.
Managers at Solstice Innovations are trained to recognize signs of burnout and to encourage use of work-life balance options.
Workshops and seminars cover stress management, resilience-building, and early detection of mental health issues to reduce stigma.
All interactions with the counseling services are strictly confidential, and seeking help will not harm career progression or job security.
Utilization rates of the services are monitored to ensure they meet employee needs.
Outcomes are assessed through anonymous participant feedback and indicators such as absenteeism, productivity, and employee satisfaction.
The company cites robust employee retention rates, high job satisfaction scores, and a vibrant corporate atmosphere as evidence of success.
